title_yt: Is a fake sick day for GTA 6 really free? #Shorts
title_fb: Is a fake sick day for GTA 6 really free?
hook: If you fake sick for G T A six, what do you pay?
open_loop: Hook asks what the sick day costs. Boss believes Benny (small win), he plays all day for nothing, and the price ($247 = more than three games) lands only in lines 4-5; line 6 closes the 'free' loop.
payoff: Pay stub -$247 = more than three generic $79.99 boxes for one day. Playing after work is the really free option.

lines.text: If you fake sick for GTA 6, what do you pay?
lines.say: If you fake sick for G T A six, what do you pay?
lines.visual: SCENE 1: Benny in office shirt and tie at desk, phone to ear, fist-cough. Hooded stranger (boss) behind him, arms crossed, squinting suspiciously. Headline 'GTA 6 SICK DAY'. SCENE 2 (on 'cost'): snap-zoom, big gold '$?' stamp slams in over the desk.

lines.text: Your boss believes you. You are free!
lines.visual: SCENE 3: Boss shrugs 'okay', Benny throws the tie, hoodie on, arms up, happy. Small confetti.

lines.text: Now you play all day. Hour after hour, it feels free.
lines.visual: SCENE 4: Benny in hoodie on a couch with a plain controller silhouette and snacks. Wall clock ticks; coin pile under his feet stays empty/shrinks. Badge 'HOUR 3'. On 'free' Benny grins, unaware, while an empty pay envelope flaps open behind him.

lines.text: No pay that day. At typical pay, that is $250.
lines.say: No pay that day. At typical pay, that is two hundred fifty dollars.
lines.visual: SCENE 5: Pay stub slaps onto Benny's face, counter drops to -$247. Badge 'TYPICAL PAY · IF UNPAID'. His grin freezes.

lines.text: More than three whole games. For one day.
lines.visual: SCENE 6: Three plain gray generic boxes (no art, no logo), each tagged '$79.99', drop one by one onto frozen Benny and bury him (thud sfx). Snap-zoom on 'three'. Hold one beat on the pile before the next line.

lines.text: Play after work. That one is really free.
lines.visual: SCENE 7: Boxes vanish. Benny at night in hoodie, happy, tie back on a hook, coins intact. Badge '$0 EXTRA'.

lines.text: Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 8 (on 'Sick day'): Benny coughing with row 'A: SICK'. SCENE 9 (on 'play after work'): Benny smug at night with row 'B: AFTER WORK'. Benny points at viewer on 'Comment'.

facts_used.claim: US median usual weekly earnings of full-time workers Q1 2026 = $1,235; full time = 35+ h/week (40 h used as an example).
GTA 6 Standard Edition price $79.99; release Nov 19, 2026.
'GTA Flu' = launch-week meme of faking sick days (no stats used).

upload.title: Is a fake sick day for GTA 6 really free? #Shorts
upload.description:
One day off can cost more than the game itself.
Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
If the day is unpaid, the typical US full-time worker (40 hours a week) loses about $247. A new game costs $79.99, so that is more than three games.
Not financial advice. Many jobs offer paid sick leave. Pay data: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (median weekly earnings).
